title: Bengal Unfolded
tagline: History is still unfolding in our present
intro: Explore connected chapters from 1757 to 2024 in a timeline-first format to trace how power, language, resistance, and democratic demands shaped Bengal and Bangladesh.
timelineSubheading: Follow the full timeline to see how each linked turning point created the conditions for the next.
whyJourneyMattersBody: These chapters are not isolated episodes. Together, they explain how memory, institutions, and civic action continue to shape rights, identity, public life, and the connected timeline that ties them together.
